sources.title: 《星學大成》四庫全書受讀卷一十干變曜所屬與變曜歌訣
sources.provider: Wikisource traditional received Siku text; separate target passage from existing registered TianChu same-volume source
sources.quality_notes: Ten changing categories 祿暗福耗蔭貴刑印囚權 paired with ten luminaries 火孛木金土月水炁計羅; 甲化貴月, 乙化福金 under cyclic per-stem offset; duplicate 䕃 before 妻妾 and 田宅 conflicts with heading 天印 and Gujin received 印. This record is NOT a new physical ancient witness, NOT the existing root TianChu rule and NOT Ming-original folio authority.

sources.title: 《古今圖書集成》藝術典卷568張果星宗二變曜與天元祿受讀及掃描索引
sources.provider: Wikisource received text with page index to public Commons Gujin Tushu Jicheng Volume 468 scan
sources.url: https://zh.wikisource.org/zh-hant/欽定古今圖書集成/博物彙編/藝術典/第568卷
sources.quality_notes: 卷内明确 藝術典第五百六十八卷; digital scan filename Volume 468 is not work juan. Page:Gujin Tushu Jicheng,_Volume_468_(1700-1725).djvu/30–32 public index marked 未校对; digitized original-page binding and image SHA not yet archived. Excerpt prints 變為印者屬田宅 vs Xingxue Siku 䕃 duplicate; indicates received textual variant, not definitive earlier original glyph. Adjacent 天元禄 adds year-stem 五虎遁 to natal palace, separate from bare ten-star mapping.
